description: Craftsman DDD review, 2026-10-05. hooks/lib/python_shell.py:52 `rejection_finding` and :62 `startup_finding` return `{**finding, "detail": ..., "action": ...}`, so the Finding shape stays implicit. The same dict pattern runs through the hook boundary repo-wide (`Finding(...).to_dict()` in comment_rules.py and others). Introduce explicit factory methods on `Finding` and pass the value object until the hook output boundary. User approved the idea on 2026-10-05. Not started.
title: Findings travel as Finding value objects, not bare dicts
